# 2 Chronicles Chapter 31 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-as-finished all this went-out all Israel the-found to-cities-of Judah and-they-broke the-pillars and-they-cut-down the-Asherim and-they-tore-down the-high-places and-the-altars from-all Judah and-Benjamin and-in-Ephraim and-Manasseh until for-finishing and-they-returned all sons-of Israel each to-his-possession to-their-cities.

**2** And-he-stationed Hezekiah the-divisions-of the-priests and-the-Levites according-to-their-divisions each according-to-his-service to-the-priests and-to-the-Levites for-burnt-offering and-for-peace-offerings to-serve and-to-give-thanks and-to-praise in-gates-of camps-of YHWH.

**3** And-portion-of the-king from-his-possessions for-the-burnt-offerings for-burnt-offerings-of the-morning and-the-evening and-the-burnt-offerings for-the-sabbaths and-for-the-new-moons and-for-the-appointed-feasts as-written in-law-of YHWH.

**4** And-he-said to-the-people the-dwelling in-Jerusalem to-give portion-of the-priests and-the-Levites so-that they-may-be-strong in-law-of YHWH.

**5** And-as-spreading the-word they-multiplied sons-of Israel first-fruits-of grain new-wine and-oil and-honey and-all produce-of the-field and-tithe-of all for-abundance they-brought.

**6** And-sons-of Israel and-Judah the-dwelling in-cities-of Judah also they tithe-of cattle and-sheep and-tithe-of holy-things the-consecrated to-YHWH their-God they-brought and-they-put heaps heaps.

**7** In-the-month the-third they-began the-heaps to-found and-in-the-month the-seventh they-finished.

**8** And-they-came Hezekiah and-the-princes and-they-saw the-heaps and-they-blessed YHWH and-His-people Israel.

**9** And-he-inquired Hezekiah about the-heaps to the-priests and-the-Levites.

**10** And-he-said to-him Azariah the-chief priest of-house-of Zadok and-he-said from-beginning the-bringing the-contribution to-house-of YHWH eating and-being-satisfied and-leaving-over to-abundance for YHWH blessed His-people and-the-remaining is-this multitude the-great.

**11** And-he-said Hezekiah to-prepare storerooms in-house-of YHWH and-they-prepared.

**12** And-they-brought the-contribution and-the-tithe and-the-holy-things in-faithfulness and-over-them was-a-leader Conaniah the-Levite and-Shimei his-brother as-second.

**13** And-Jehiel and-Azaziah and-Nahath and-Asahel and-Jerimoth and-Jozabad and-Eliel and-Ismachiah and-Mahath and-Benaiah overseers under-hand-of Conaniah and-Shimei his-brother by-appointment-of Hezekiah the-king and-Azariah ruler-of house-of God.

**14** And-Kore son-of Imnah the-Levite the-gatekeeper to-the-east was-over freewill-offerings-of God to-give contribution-of YHWH and-the-most-holy-things.

**15** And-under-his-hand Eden and-Miniamin and-Jeshua and-Shemaiah Amariah and-Shecaniah in-cities-of the-priests in-faithfulness to-give to-their-brothers in-divisions as-the-great as-the-small.

**16** Besides their-registering of-males from-son-of three years and-upward to-every one-entering house-of YHWH for-duty-of day by-day for-their-service in-their-duties according-to-their-divisions.

**17** And registration-of the-priests by-house-of their-fathers and-the-Levites from-son-of twenty years and-upward in-their-duties in-their-divisions.

**18** And-to-register in-all their-little-ones their-wives and-their-sons and-their-daughters for-all the-assembly for in-their-faithfulness they-consecrated-themselves in-holiness.

**19** And-for-sons-of Aaron the-priests in-fields-of pasture-of their-cities in-every city and-city men who were-designated by-names to-give portions to-every male among-the-priests and-to-every one-registered among-the-Levites.

**20** And-he-did so Hezekiah in-all Judah and-he-did the-good and-the-right and-the-faithful before YHWH his-God.

**21** And-in-every work that he-began in-service-of house-of God and-in-the-law and-in-the-commandment to-seek his-God with-all his-heart he-did and-he-prospered.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **31:1**: they-broke the-pillars — The reform extends beyond Judah into Ephraim and Manasseh. The people themselves, not just the king, carry out the destruction of idolatry.

- **31:4**: so-that they-may-be-strong in-law-of YHWH — Financial support enables spiritual leadership. The priests and Levites cannot devote themselves to Torah if they must earn their living elsewhere.

- **31:10**: YHWH blessed His-people — Azariah's report links generosity to divine blessing. The abundance of contributions is itself evidence of God's favor.

- **31:21**: with-all his-heart he-did and-he-prospered — The Chronicler's formula reaches its fullest expression in Hezekiah: wholehearted devotion produces comprehensive success.


— EMET
